1. (Currently amended) A composition comprising:
a) an active ingredient comprising an indole compound of formula I;
b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles; and
c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action,
wherein said composition is formulated for topical application to treat acne vulgaris.

3. (Currently amended) A composition for topical use comprising:
a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1;
b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles; and
c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action.

4. (Currently amended) The composition according to Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

5. (Currently amended) A composition according to Claim 1, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight.

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition for treating acne vulgaris.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition suitable for treatment of acne vulgaris.

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development in subjects with acne-related hair conditions.

10. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the treatment of skin conditions associated with defective keratinisation.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for treatment of acne vulgaris.

13. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the treatment of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin.

14. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the treatment of time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, in particular for treatment of dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the reduction or prevention of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin.
